1	# UI\Icons — Runtime Icon Registry
     2	
     3	The `UI\Icons` namespace provides a PHP-level API for querying all icons
     4	available in the framework and (optionally) the application, returning typed
     5	value objects that carry the icon's metadata and a factory method to
     6	instantiate the matching `UI_Icon`.
     7	
     8	## Classes
     9	
    10	### `IconCollection` — Singleton Registry
    11	
    12	`IconCollection` is the primary entry point. It loads both the framework icon
    13	JSON file and the (optional) application custom icon JSON file, merges them,
    14	and exposes the result through a typed PHP API.
    15	
    16	```php
    17	use UI\Icons\IconCollection;
    18	
    19	$icons = IconCollection::getInstance();
    20	
    21	// All icons, sorted alphabetically by ID
    22	foreach($icons->getAll() as $icon) {
    23	    echo $icon->getID() . ' → ' . $icon->getFullIconName();
    24	}
    25	
    26	// Look up a specific icon by ID (normalised form: underscores, not hyphens)
    27	$icon = $icons->getByID('time_tracker');
    28	
    29	// Create a UI_Icon instance for rendering
    30	$uiIcon = $icon->createIcon();
    31	
    32	// Split by source
    33	$standard = $icons->getStandardIcons();
    34	$custom   = $icons->getCustomIcons();
    35	```
    36	
    37	**JSON sources:**
    38	
    39	| Source | Path | Required |
    40	|---|---|---|
    41	| Framework icons | `APP_INSTALL_FOLDER/themes/default/icons.json` | Yes |
    42	| Application custom icons | `APP_ROOT/themes/custom-icons.json` | No |
    43	
    44	**Key behaviours:**
    45	
    46	- IDs are normalised on load: hyphens and spaces become underscores.
    47	- Custom icons override standard icons with the same normalised ID.
    48	- The merged collection is sorted alphabetically by ID.
    49	- The singleton is created on first `getInstance()` call and reused thereafter.
    50	
    51	**`getByID()` normalisation precondition:**
    52	
    53	`getByID()` performs a direct map lookup — it does **not** normalise its
    54	input. Always pass the normalised ID form (underscores) or the method will
    55	throw a `\RuntimeException`. When the source ID is a raw JSON key that may
    56	contain hyphens, normalise it first:
    57	
    58	```php
    59	$normalisedID = str_replace(array('-', ' '), '_', $rawID);
    60	$icon = $icons->getByID($normalisedID);
    61	```
    62	
    63	`getByID()` throws `\RuntimeException` (not `ApplicationException`) because a
    64	missing ID signals a programmer error — the collection is fully loaded at
    65	construction time, so the caller is responsible for passing a valid ID. To
    66	guard against an unknown ID at runtime, call `idExists()` first:
    67	
    68	```php
    69	if($icons->idExists($normalisedID)) {
    70	    $icon = $icons->getByID($normalisedID);
    71	}
    72	```
    73	
    74	> **Test coverage:** `tests/AppFrameworkTests/UI/IconCollectionTest.php` covers
    75	> all 7 acceptance criteria with 14 tests and 234 assertions.
    76	
    77	---
    78	
    79	### `IconInfo` — Read-Only Icon Value Object
    80	
    81	`IconInfo` is returned by all `IconCollection` query methods. It is a simple
    82	value object with no side effects.
    83	
    84	| Method | Returns | Description |
    85	|---|---|---|
    86	| `getID()` | `string` | Normalised icon ID (underscores) |
    87	| `getIconName()` | `string` | FontAwesome icon name (e.g. `exclamation-triangle`) |
    88	| `getPrefix()` | `string` | FA prefix/type (e.g. `far`, `fas`; empty = default `fa`) |
    89	| `isCustom()` | `bool` | `true` for application custom icons |
    90	| `isStandard()` | `bool` | `true` for framework standard icons; mutually exclusive with `isCustom()` |
    91	| `createIcon()` | `UI_Icon` | Creates a `UI_Icon` with this icon's type pre-configured |
    92	| `getMethodName()` | `string` | camelCase method name for use in code generation (e.g. `time_tracker` → `timeTracker`) |
    93	| `getFullIconName()` | `string` | `prefix:name` when prefix is non-empty, bare `name` otherwise |
    94	
    95	---
    96	
    97	## Relationship to the Build-Time Layer
    98	
    99	The `UI\Icons` namespace is the **runtime** side. The **build-time** counterpart
   100	lives in `Application\Composer\IconBuilder\` and operates on the same JSON
